Made by 엔피케이(주) · Once a day · 2 tablets

This product combines 100mg of Vitamin C, 10mg of Zinc, 210mg of Calcium, 40mg of Propolis as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (2 tablets): 100mg Vitamin C, 10mg Zinc, 210mg Calcium, 40mg Propolis
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 엔피케이(주)

  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Calcium
    • Needed for the formation of bones and teeth
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Propolis
    • May help with antioxidant activity

Once a day2 tablets per servingWith water

Vitamin C labelled (100mg / 2600mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (10mg / 2600mg), 80~150%
Calcium labelled (210mg / 2600mg), 80~150%
Propolis labelled (40mg / 2600mg), 80~120%

Coliform Negative

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Vitamin C · Zinc · Calcium · Propolis together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have a condition or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
